one_liner: Pipedrive has a broad REST API (v1/v2) with self-serve OAuth 2.0 app registration, API tokens, a free developer sandbox, and an official MCP server, so a toolkit is buildable now.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow; apps are registered in the Developer Hub to get a client_id and client_secret. Personal API tokens also work and are tied to one user.
access_notes: A free developer sandbox account can be requested via developers.pipedrive.com. The product has no free plan, but a 14-day no-card trial exists, and API tokens come with every plan. One source says API access needs a paid account, which is why the access confidence is medium.
blocker_notes: Nothing major. The sandbox is requested rather than instant, but the 14-day trial and API tokens on every plan are fallbacks. The daily token budget is a rate limit, not friction.

evidence.quote: Apps registered in the [Developer Hub](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/marketplace-oauth-authorization) receive a client_id and client_secret.
The API token can be [obtained](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/how-to-find-the-api-token) manually from the Pipedrive app.
